scripts.build: rm -rf build && mkdir -p build && cp index.html how-it-works.html alliance.html workstreams.html principles.html news.html guiding-principles.html board.html roi.html press-release.html build/ && cp -r img build/ && if [ -n "$GA_MEASUREMENT_ID" ]; then find build -maxdepth 1 -name '*.html' -exec sed -i "s|__GA_MEASUREMENT_ID__|$GA_MEASUREMENT_ID|g" {} +; else echo "GA_MEASUREMENT_ID is not set; analytics placeholders were not replaced."; fi
